documents.text: to the British in 1780, he was sent as a prisoner of war to St. Augustine, Florida (along with Edward Rutledge and Thomas Heyward Jr.), until exchanged in July the following year. Middleton died on June 15, 1790 at the age of 47 and was buried in the family tomb in the Gardens at Middleton Place. The death notice from the "State Gazette of South-Carolina" (SC), June 18, 1790, described him as a "tender husband and parent, humane master, steady unshaken patriot, the gentleman, and the scholar." The plantation then passed to Henry, his eldest son, later Governor of South Carolina.
